# Review localized product copy against actual functionality

A translated product name is not enough. Subtitles, screenshots, feature descriptions, and purchase details should all describe the same product.

## Compare meaning, not just fluency

Match each translated claim to an actual feature or screen. A polished sentence about an unrelated workflow is still incorrect. If the source wording is ambiguous, resolve the feature description before translating it.

## Walk through the purchase path

Check the landing page, product page, account form, checkout handoff, and delivery instructions. Note where a visitor unexpectedly switches language or loses the context of the selected product.

## Review presentation

Inspect longer labels, smaller screens, currency wording, dates, and units. Confirm that language-switch links lead to the corresponding page rather than an unrelated default screen.

## Keep reviewed copy reproducible

Record corrected fields and why they changed. If the catalog is imported from another system, keep corrections in a place that survives the next import. Recheck the generated pages after a sync.
